name: TSM Corporation
old_description: TSM is a full-service manufacturer of custom components for automotive powertrain, driveline, and chassis applications.
about:
TSM Corporation is based in Auburn Hills, Michigan. Founded in 1978, the company began with 10 employees, a single rotary dial machine, and three drill presses. Over more than four decades it has grown into a multi-location operation with 200,000 square feet of production space and 180-plus employees.

The company operates as a full-service manufacturer of custom components for automotive powertrain, driveline, and chassis applications. Its capabilities span the entire manufacturing process from design through start of production, supported by 40-plus dedicated machining centers, 200-plus production machines, and 24/7 operations. TSM manages in-house tooling and re-tooling, and has delivered design optimizations such as a 25 percent mass reduction and part consolidation on a structural support program.

TSM serves the automotive industry, working with multiple global OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers across more than 40 vehicle platforms. Notable engagements include taking over a failing intake manifold program for a leading global OEM and re-tooling it within five weeks, and developing a structural support that reduced mass and combined two part numbers for another major automotive manufacturer.

The company emphasizes agile production, positioning itself as a trusted partner for launching new products on tight milestones with high quality. Its quality culture engages all employees and business partners, underpinned by IATF 16949 and ISO 14001 certifications. TSM's stated mission is to achieve unsurpassed manufacturing quality through intelligent, cost-effective solutions for complicated engineering designs, leveraging global partnerships and a highly qualified workforce.
